test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Electrician) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following uses of wire gauge is INCORRECT?

options.text: It measures the diameter of a wire.
It is used in electrical installations, welding and other applications.
It does not help determine how much current a wire can carry.
Using the wrong wire gauge can damage appliances and electronic devices.

solution:
__**Wire Gauge**__

Wire gauge is a standard system used to indicate the diameter or thickness of an electrical wire. It helps determine how much **current a wire can safely **carry.

**Key Points:**

 
• The most commonly used system is AWG (American Wire Gauge).
 
• Smaller gauge number → thicker wire → higher current capacity.
 
• Larger gauge number → thinner wire → lower current capacity.
 
• Wire gauge affects: Current-carrying capacity, Electrical resistance, Heating, voltage drop, and Mechanical strength
